name: Base extraction
notesExpectations: Has note about loving surfing in appropriate group (Interests or similar)

name: Contradiction handling
inputs: Actually, I don't like coffee anymore
notesExpectations: Does NOT have note about loving coffee. Has note indicating user no longer likes coffee or doesn't like coffee

name: Duplicate detection
notesExpectations: Has notes about guitar and hiking. Does NOT have duplicate notes about guitar - guitar mentioned only once across all notes

name: Multi extraction
inputs: What languages do you think I should focus on?
notesExpectations: Has notes about learning Spanish and living in Barcelona in appropriate groups

name: Group separation
inputs: Remind me to call mom tomorrow
notesExpectations: Has notes about being software engineer and valuing work-life balance. Task/reminder about calling mom should be in Tasks/Events group, not mixed with other info

name: Update without contradiction
inputs: I especially love surfing in winter
notesExpectations: Has notes about loving surfing and winter surfing preference. Information should be combined or enhanced, not duplicated

name: Implicit extraction
inputs: I'm vegan, so I can't eat that
notesExpectations: Has note mentioning user is vegan

name: Negation extraction
notesExpectations: Has note that user is not a morning person or dislikes mornings
